npcs.name: Kasa (Guild Branch Head)
npcs.description: A broad-shouldered woman of about forty with an old blade scar down her left cheek. A former A-rank adventurer, she has run the Jadestone branch since she hung up her sword. Hard on newcomers, but fair.

npcs.name: Ironpost (Mine Foreman)
npcs.description: A middle-aged miner as burly as an iron tower. He runs the mine's daily operations and is also a faithful believer at the Dawnlight Chapel. A familiar face from the caravan road.

npcs.name: Old Vance, 'Crow-Eye' (Ore Appraiser)
npcs.description: A gaunt old man, gold left eye and black right eye — said to be the remnant of some ancient bloodline. Jadestone's most authoritative ore appraiser; there's no stone he can't see through.

npcs.name: Wren (Tavern Keeper)
npcs.description: A young woman in her twenties, loud-voiced with a hearty laugh. She inherited the Jade-Crystal Tavern from her father. Knows all there is to know about the town's gossip.

npcs.name: Granny Green (Herbalist)
npcs.description: A hunched, white-haired old woman, forever grinding herbs in her shop. She knows every plant in the mountains, and injured miners all come to her. Especially kind to young women.

npcs.name: Damon the Hammer (Shopkeeper)
npcs.description: A short, stocky middle-aged man missing two fingers on his left hand — a memento of a mine collapse. After switching to the sundries trade he's made a tidy fortune; his stock is complete and his prices are fair.

npcs.name: Father Silas (Chapel Priest)
npcs.description: A middle-aged priest, gaunt of face but warm of gaze. Ten years ago he was sent from the great cathedral of Mistlake to Jadestone. Besides preaching, he also heals the poor for free.

npcs.name: Rowan Pike
npcs.description: A young adventurer in his twenties, getting by in Jadestone but never getting ahead, forever wanting to seize one lead big enough to change his fate. Lately he's fixed on the old northern legend of the 'world's edge': supposedly there's a bottomless cave there that keeps digging up relics of no known age and rare items with wondrous powers.
